name: Washington
gaps: The Sound Transit RTA tax is computed on the MSRP; when the form has no MSRP the engine uses the price, which understates the tax on a used car. Type the original MSRP for the exact figure.

Whether an address pays the RTA tax depends on the Sound Transit district boundary. The engine follows the Department of Revenue location codes marked Non-RTA; for cities DOR does not split, it treats a city as inside the district when its local rate includes the 1.4% Sound Transit sales tax. Check an address with Sound Transit before relying on it.

A used car keeps its Washington tabs, so registration, RTA, EV and district fees are shown as due at the next renewal; the exact amount depends on the renewal month (tabs can be prorated), which the form does not ask.

Light trucks pay a license fee by declared gross weight; the engine reads the weight typed as the declared gross weight and applies the 2% increase the statute requires from July 1, 2026 (rounded to five cents). DOL did not publish the adjusted table on a page read for this release.
Plug-in hybrids are given the electric vehicle fees, which apply to plug-ins with 30 miles or more of electric range; a plug-in with less range pays the $75 hybrid fee instead.
Optional items are left out: the $5 state parks donation, personalized or special plates, and the $50 quick-title fee.

singular: Since January 1, 2026 every car sale carries an extra 0.5% motor vehicle sales/use tax on top of the 6.5% state rate and the local rate, up from 0.3% [dor-mvsut].
A car priced above $100,000 also pays an 8% luxury tax on the price plus the trade-in above $102,000 from July 1, 2026 [dor-luxury].

In the Sound Transit district of King, Pierce and Snohomish counties, owners pay a 1.1% car tab tax on the MSRP reduced by a state schedule, 95% in the second year of service and 10% from the thirteenth [dol-rta].
The 0.3% part of the Sound Transit car tab tax approved in 1996 expires in 2028, which will bring it down to 0.8% [st-taxes].
Since October 1, 2026 the title application fee is $40 when a dealer sells the car, against $15 for other title applications [rcw-46-17-100].
A new car gets two original plates at $50 each plus $2 of reflectivity fee per plate [rcw-46-17-200].
Electric cars pay $150 in EV fees plus a $75 transportation electrification fee at each renewal, and hybrids $75, but none of these is due at the first registration [rcw-46-17-323].
Cities such as Seattle ($50), Vancouver ($50) or Lake Forest Park ($50) add a transportation benefit district fee at each tab renewal [dol-tbd].
Dealers may charge a documentary service fee of up to $200, and that fee is not subject to sales tax [dor-doc-fee].
Washington ended its emission check program on January 1, 2020, and has no safety inspection [ecology].

rcw-82-08-020.name: RCW 82.08.020, retail sales tax (as amended by 2025 c 417)
rcw-82-08-020.quote: (1) There is levied and collected a tax equal to six and five-tenths percent of the selling price on each retail sale in this state of: ... (3) There is levied and collected an additional tax of five-tenths of one percent of the selling price on each retail sale of a motor vehicle in this state

dor-mvsut.name: Washington Department of Revenue, Motor vehicle sales/use tax
dor-mvsut.quote: If sales tax was not paid at the time of purchase, use tax applies at the time the vehicle is registered with the Department of Licensing. ... Effective Jan. 1, 2026, the rate is 0.5% (0.005).

dor-rates.name: Washington Department of Revenue, Car Dealers and Leasing Companies Local Sales & Use Tax Rates, Oct. 1 - Dec. 31, 2026
dor-rates.quote: Effective October 1 - December 31, 2026 ... King Seattle 1726 .0405 .0650 .1055 ... (1) Combined sales tax includes the 6.5% state rate, and the local rate.

dor-luxury.name: Washington Department of Revenue, Luxury motor vehicle tax
dor-luxury.quote: Starting Jan. 1, 2026, it is an 8% tax on the sale or lease of a new or used motor vehicle priced at more than $100,000. ... the taxable amount is the selling price plus trade-in property, minus the current deduction amount. ... July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027 | $102,000

dor-trade-ins.name: Washington Department of Revenue, Auto dealers guide: Trade-ins
dor-trade-ins.quote: For purposes of the retail sales tax measure, the selling price excludes "trade-in property of like kind." This means that dealers will collect retail sales tax from retail customers on the price after the value of the trade-in is deducted.

doc-fee.name: RCW 46.70.180(2), dealer documentary service fee
doc-fee.quote: However, an amount not to exceed $200 per vehicle sale or lease may be charged by a dealer to recover administrative costs for collecting motor vehicle excise taxes, licensing and registration fees and other agency fees

dor-doc-fee.name: Washington Department of Revenue, Auto dealers guide: Document service fees
dor-doc-fee.quote: Effective July 1, 2022, a dealer can charge up to $200. Document service fees are not subject to sales tax.

rcw-46-17-100.name: RCW 46.17.100, certificate of title application fee (effective Oct. 1, 2026)
rcw-46-17-100.quote: Through December 31, 2036, the fee is $40 upon the execution of a retail sale or lease agreement, with respect to the retail sale or lease by a motor vehicle dealer or lessor of a new or used motor vehicle ... For all other certificate of title applications, the fee is $15.

rcw-46-17-005.name: RCW 46.17.005, filing fees
rcw-46-17-005.quote: (1) A person who applies for a vehicle registration ... shall pay a $6 filing fee in addition to any other fees and taxes required by law. (2) A person who applies for a certificate of title shall pay a $6.50 filing fee

rcw-46-17-040.name: RCW 46.17.040, service fees
rcw-46-17-040.quote: (a) $18 for changes in a certificate of title, changes in ownership for nontitled vehicles ... (b) $11 for a registration renewal, issuing a transit permit, or any other service under this section

rcw-46-17-110.name: RCW 46.17.110, emergency medical services fee
rcw-46-17-110.quote: shall require the applicant to pay a six dollar and fifty cent emergency medical services fee for the following transactions: (a) All retail sales or leases of any new or used motor vehicles; and (b) Original and transfer certificate of title transactions.

rcw-19-118-110.name: RCW 19.118.110, new motor vehicle arbitration fee
rcw-19-118-110.quote: If the new motor vehicle will be registered in the state of Washington, a three-dollar arbitration fee shall be collected by either the new motor vehicle dealer or vehicle lessor from the consumer upon execution of a retail sale or lease agreement.

rcw-46-17-200.name: RCW 46.17.200, license plate fees
rcw-46-17-200.quote: The following license plate fees for each license plate ... Original issue | $50.00 ... Reflectivity | $2.00 ... Replacement | $30.00

rcw-46-17-350.name: RCW 46.17.350, vehicle license fees by vehicle type

rcw-46-17-365.name: RCW 46.17.365, motor vehicle weight fee (registrations due on or after Jan. 1, 2026)
rcw-46-17-365.quote: For vehicle registrations that are due or become due on or after January 1, 2026, the motor vehicle weight fee: (a) Must be based on the motor vehicle scale weight as follows: 4,000 pounds $35.00 6,000 pounds $65.00 8,000 pounds $82.50 16,000 pounds and over $96.00

rcw-46-17-355.name: RCW 46.17.355, license fees by declared gross weight
rcw-46-17-355.quote: 4,000 pounds $53.00 ... 6,000 pounds $80.00 ... 8,000 pounds $110.00 ... 10,000 pounds $140.00 ... (8) Beginning July 1, 2026, the vehicle license fee ... must be adjusted annually by increasing the fee by two percent and the result must be rounded to the nearest five cents.

rcw-46-17-025.name: RCW 46.17.025, license service fee
rcw-46-17-025.quote: A person who applies for a vehicle registration or for any other right to operate a vehicle on the highways of this state shall pay a 75 cent license service fee in addition to any other fees and taxes required by law.

rcw-46-17-015.name: RCW 46.17.015, license plate technology fee
rcw-46-17-015.quote: A person who applies for a vehicle registration or for any other right to operate a vehicle on the highways of this state shall pay a 25 cent license plate technology fee in addition to any other fees and taxes required by law.

rcw-46-17-323.name: RCW 46.17.323, electric vehicle registration renewal fees
rcw-46-17-323.quote: is capable of traveling at least 30 miles using only battery power ... must require the applicant to pay a $100 fee in addition to any other fees and taxes required by law. The $100 fee is due only at the time of annual registration renewal. ... the applicant to pay a $50 fee.

rcw-46-17-324.name: RCW 46.17.324, transportation electrification fee
rcw-46-17-324.quote: is subject to an annual seventy-five dollar transportation electrification fee ... may only be collected for vehicles that are renewing an annual vehicle registration. ... pay a seventy-five dollar hybrid vehicle transportation electrification fee

dol-rta.name: Washington State Department of Licensing, Regional Transit Authority (RTA) tax
dol-rta.quote: Current year - year of vehicle + 1 = years of service ... Original MSRP x depreciated percentage = depreciated value ... Depreciated value x 1.1% (current RTA rate) = RTA amount due ... 1 | 100% | 2 | 95% | 3 | 89% | 4 | 83% | 5 | 74% | 6 | 65%

st-taxes.quote: Car tabs (MVET) | 1.1% ($110 per every $10,000 of vehicle’s value, annually) ... Sales and use tax | 1.4% ... The 0.3% car tab tax approved by voters in 1996 will expire in 2028.

ecology.name: Washington Department of Ecology, Emission check program ended
ecology.quote: After 38 years, Washington’s emission check program ended Jan. 1, 2020. ... vehicle owners are no longer required to have their vehicle’s emissions tested before renewing their vehicle registration.
